Application guide · your team, trained

Simple for your therapists.

1

Apply sparingly

For best results use sparingly — preferably less than 35ml per session. Maximum value from every drop.

2

Client develops

One layer develops on the skin for a minimum of 6–8 hours before washing off in a tepid shower.

3

Express option

For an express result, a second layer after 5 minutes — developed in just 3–4 hours.
